records.text: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,
“Son of man, turn your face toward Mount Seir and prophesy against it,
and say, ‘Thus says the Lord, the Lord: Behold, I am against you, Mount Seir. I will stretch My hand against you and make you a wilderness, and you will be laid waste.
I will make your cities desolate, and you will be a wilderness. You will know that I am the Lord.
Because you became an everlasting enemy and ambushed Israel’s house treacherously, by enemies’ hand, with a sword at the final time of injustice,
therefore, I live, says the Lord, the Lord: surely you sinned unto blood, and blood will pursue you.
I will make Mount Seir a wilderness and lay it waste, and destroy human beings and livestock from it,
and fill the hills and your ravines with your wounded. In all your plains, those wounded by the sword will fall within you.
I will make you an everlasting wilderness, and your cities certainly will not be inhabited again. You will know that I am the Lord.
Because you said, “The two nations and the two countries will be mine, and I will inherit them,” and the Lord is there,
therefore, I live, says the Lord: I will deal with you according to your hostility and make Myself known to you when I judge you.
You will know that I am the Lord. I heard the voice of your blasphemies, because you said, “Israel’s mountains are desolate; they have been given to us for food.”
You spoke grandly against Me with your mouth. I heard.
Thus says the Lord: In the rejoicing of the whole earth, I will make you a wilderness.
You will be a wilderness, Mount Seir, and all Idumea will be utterly consumed. You will know that I am the Lord their God.’”
Thus says the Lord: Because Idumea acted in vengeance against Judah’s house, and they bore a grudge and exacted punishment,
therefore thus says the Lord: I will stretch My hand against Idumea and utterly destroy human and animal from her. I will make her a wilderness, and those pursued from Thaiman will fall by the sword.
I will place My vengeance upon Idumea by the hand of My people Israel. They will act in Idumea according to My anger and My wrath, and they will recognize My vengeance, says the Lord.
You shall not speak peace unto them, nor seek their advantage, all your days for ever.
You shall not abhor an Edomite, for he is your brother; you shall not abhor an Egyptian, for you were a resident alien in his land.
Together all my enemies whispered against me; against me they devised evils for me.
They laid a lawless word against me: “Can it be that the one lying down will not rise again?”
For even the man of my peace, in whom I hoped, who ate my loaves, magnified treachery against me.
But Thou, Lord, have mercy on me and raise me up, and I will repay them.
By this I knew that Thou didst desire me: my enemy will certainly not rejoice over me.
And he took up his parable and said: Balaam son of Beor declares; the man who sees truly declares,
one who hears God's oracles, who knows knowledge from the Most High and has seen a vision of God in sleep, with his eyes uncovered:

I will show him, but not now; I pronounce him blessed, but he does not draw near. A star shall rise from Jacob, and a man shall arise from Israel. He shall crush Moab's leaders and plunder all the sons of Seth.
And Edom shall become an inheritance, and Esau, his enemy, shall become an inheritance; Israel acted with strength.
And one shall arise from Jacob and destroy whoever escapes from a city.
And now, thus said the Lord, Israel’s God, concerning the city of which you say, It will be handed over to Babylon’s king by sword, famine, and a sent affliction:
I am gathering them from all the land where I scattered them in My anger, wrath, and great indignation. I will bring them back to this place and settle them in confidence.
They will be My people, and I will be their God.
I will give them another way and another heart, to fear Me always, for their good and their children’s good after them.
I will establish an eternal covenant with them, which I will certainly not turn back from behind them. I will put My fear in their heart so that they do not depart from Me.
I will attend to them to do them good and will plant them in this land in faithfulness, with all heart and all soul.
For thus said the Lord: Just as I brought all these great calamities upon this people, so I will bring upon them all the good things I spoke concerning them.
Fields will again be acquired in the land of which you say, It is untrodden by people and animals, and they were handed over to the Chaldeans.

They will acquire fields with silver, and you will write a document, seal it, and call witnesses in Benjamin’s land, around Jerusalem, in Judah’s cities, the hill-country cities, the cities of the Shephelah, and the cities of the Negeb, because I will bring back their exiles.

“And it shall be after these things, that I will pour out of My Spirit upon all flesh; and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, your elders shall dream dreams, and your young men shall see visions.
Even upon male slaves and female slaves in those days I will pour out of My Spirit.
I will give wonders in heaven and upon the earth: blood, fire and a vapor of smoke.
The sun will turn to darkness and the moon to blood before the coming of the Lord’s great and manifest day.
Everyone who calls upon the Lord’s name will be saved, for on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem there will be one who escapes, as the Lord said, and bearers of good news whom the Lord has called.”
All the limits of the earth will remember and turn to the Lord, and all the families of the nations will bow down before Thee,
because kingship belongs to the Lord, and He is master of the nations.
